Reigniting the Verdant Years Chapter 100: Ying Chanxi Likes Dolls

During the National Day holiday, Lu Wei had a very fulfilling time.

Especially in the first two days, when he successfully asked Gao Yuqin out, which left him beaming.

The only shame was that Gao Yuqin also brought two of her best friends, so it wasn't a world for just the two of them.

But for Lu Wei, this was already a solid step forward.

There was just one thing that was rather annoying.

Gao Yuqin's best friends were two girls from Class 8 next door, named Jin Yuting and Ren Zheng.

During their conversations, they would occasionally bring up that Class 8 monitor, Li Luo, which annoyed Lu Wei to no end.

But Gao Yuqin looked interested and would sometimes share her interactions with Li Luo during student council meetings, so Lu Wei couldn't very well interrupt their chat. He could only follow along quietly and carry their bags for them.

And so, when the National Day holiday ended, the students returned to campus.

Lu Wei waited at the back door of Class 8 during lunch and found Li Luo.

"You're Li Luo, right?" Lu Wei called Li Luo over to a corner, squinting his eyes.

"Is there something you need, student?" Li Luo looked at the guy, completely baffled. "You're from Class 7, aren't you?"

"That's right. It seems you've been observing me too." Lu Wei nodded. The fact that Li Luo remembered him had already led him to a conclusion. "Since that's the case, some things will be easier to say."

"Uh... go on. I'm in a hurry to get lunch."

"Then I'll be direct." Lu Wei crossed his arms, his aura imposing. "I don't like to beat around the bush when I do things. So, let's make a deal, or you could call it a bet."

"...You were saying?"

"To put it simply," Lu Wei cleared his throat and said very seriously, "the mid-term exams are coming up. Let's compete. The one with the lower score is not allowed to approach Gao Yuqin on their own initiative anymore."

Li Luo: "..."

Looking at this brother before him, all serious and full of fighting spirit, Li Luo fell silent for a moment.

He was thinking, so even at Fuyi High, there were guys with this kind of mindset.

But they were still high school students, an age when hormones were raging. He might as well try to be understanding.

"Student Lu Wei, there's something you should know first," Li Luo kindly reminded him. "I've never taken the initiative to talk to your class monitor. This bet of yours has no binding power over me."

"How is that possible?" Lu Wei's eyebrows shot up. "Don't be a coward who won't own up to what he did. When Gao Yuqin went out with me during National Day, she mentioned you. You two often chat at student council meetings."

"Huh?" Li Luo was stunned for a moment. He carefully recalled last month's regular meeting several times. Aside from a few words when greeting her and passing documents, he didn't seem to have had any other interactions with Gao Yuqin.

How did it become "often chat" when it came out of Gao Yuqin's mouth?

Li Luo's mouth twitched, and he said directly, "In any case, you don't need to make any bets with me. I don't usually look for Gao Yuqin."

"Scared, are you?" Lu Wei sneered.

He had specifically asked around. Li Luo's grades weren't bad; his total for the three main subjects in the placement exam was 316, ranking 14th in his class.

But Lu Wei's grades were also good, with a score of 320 in the placement exam, so he still had an advantage.

Just then, a voice came from beyond the corner.

"Li Luo, are you done yet?" Yan Zhusheng poked her head over. "I'm hungry."

"Coming, coming." Li Luo made a gesture to her, then pointed at Yan Zhusheng and looked at Lu Wei. "You see, my deskmate is much prettier than Gao Yuqin. You should save yourself the trouble, bro. I'm really not interested in her."

After speaking, Li Luo patted Lu Wei's shoulder, then quickly walked out of the corner and waved to Yan Zhusheng. "Let's go, time for lunch."

"Oh."

Starting today, Teacher Sun from Class 1 would be holding noon tutoring sessions for some students who performed well in the Math Club.

So Ying Chanxi couldn't have lunch with them.

Xu Youyu also found it a waste of time to gather up every time, so he went straight to lunch with his classmates.

That left just Li Luo and Yan Zhusheng, heading to the cafeteria together.

"That person, what did he want with you?" Yan Zhusheng asked curiously.

"Nothing much." Li Luo shook his head helplessly. "The unique restlessness of youth, where the little head controls the big head. He got carried away."

"Huh?" Yan Zhusheng was a bit confused. "What head?"

"The girl that guy likes seems to have a bit of a crush on me, so he came to compete with me," Li Luo rephrased it in words Yan Zhusheng could understand. "It's nothing, really."

"So do you have a crush on me too?" Yan Zhusheng asked.

"Why are you asking that?"

"I heard you say I was pretty."

"Were you eavesdropping on our conversation?"

"You pointed at me when you said it. I couldn't help but hear."

"But I was just stating a fact."

"Then you're more handsome than that guy just now."

"Mm, a teachable student." Li Luo nodded in praise. "You see, you stated a fact too."

"Li Luo, I'm not dumb." Yan Zhusheng narrowed her eyes slightly. "You seem a little shameless."

"Being a little clever at a time like this is, in itself, a form of foolishness."

Ever since she had become familiar with Li Luo, Yan Zhusheng had started to talk more, though she still spoke very little with other students.

She quite liked talking to Li Luo, finding it very interesting, unlike those who sent her love letters with contents that always made her frown.

The two of them walked all the way to the second floor of the cafeteria, queued up to buy their food, and found a corner table to sit down.

A short while later, two people walked up to them, asking with their trays, "Is anyone sitting here?"

"No, please sit." Li Luo looked up and saw they were acquaintances.

"Hello, Li Luo." Liu Shaowen sat down across from them with Liao Hailin and handed two drinks to Li Luo and Yan Zhusheng. "Long time no see. This is on me."

"Uh... it's only been a week." Li Luo glanced at the drinks, wondering what he was up to. "We just saw each other at the Literature Club before the National Day holiday."

"Speaking of the Literature Club," Liu Shaowen chuckled, "you still haven't replied to my letter. It's truly heartbreaking."

"Isn't it enough that Ying Chanxi replied to you?" Li Luo shot him a look.

"But I wrote her another letter after that, and there's been no follow-up," Liu Shaowen said sincerely. "You know her better. Can we keep in touch more often so you can tell me more about her?"

Although Liu Shaowen had admired Ying Chanxi since middle school, they were unfortunately not in the same class, and he had little time to get to know her.

Now that fate had placed them in the same class, Liu Shaowen felt he should seize the opportunity.

That Xie Shuchen had been making aggressive moves lately, and he couldn't fall behind. At the very least, he had to build a good relationship with Ying Chanxi's cousin.

Hearing Liu Shaowen's words, Li Luo didn't know whether to laugh or cry, thinking what on earth was all this about.

"Ying Chanxi... she likes fluffy stuffed animals." Li Luo thought about it and decided that a bottle of soda was worth this much information, so he told Liu Shaowen.

Ying Chanxi slept with the panda doll he had given her every night, so what he said should be correct.

"I see." Liu Shaowen had a great epiphany, and his face instantly lit up with excitement. "Thanks!"

Xie Shuchen, oh, Xie Shuchen, you may hover around Ying Chanxi all day and be lucky enough to be chosen by Teacher Sun to attend her tutoring sessions with her, but so what?

If you don't even understand her, how can you make any progress?

At this thought, Liu Shaowen started shoveling rice into his mouth a little faster.

Li Luo watched him with a speechless expression.

In his memories, Ying Chanxi seemed to have never been in a relationship, even before his rebirth, remaining single well into her thirties.

This brother, Liu Shaowen, was making a completely futile effort.

However, it wasn't Li Luo's place to stop him.

After lunch, on the way back to the classroom, Yan Zhusheng turned her head and asked, "Does Xixi like stuffed animals?"

"I think so."

"Oh." Yan Zhusheng's expression was pensive.

(End of this chapter)
